decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing that SEL is hardwired to GND and that I2C is the required operating mode.
The source concerns the SPS30 module-side SEL pin, not the power or signal interfaces connecting the project boards.
Grounding the SPS30 mode-selection pin does not change the established 3.3V logic compatibility or level-shifter policy.
The SPS30 SEL electrical connection does not alter the main board's dimensions, placement, orientation, or connector-access requirements.
The SPS30 mode-selection wiring does not change which power rails are monitored or the monitoring topology.
The source addresses the SPS30 SEL pin and has no effect on the ESP32 BOOT or reset circuitry.
Hardwiring SPS30 SEL to GND selects its communication mode but does not change its 5V supply or switched-rail control.
The reference to SPS30 pin 4 is unrelated to the PWRON signal on J_PWR_SIG pin 4 and does not modify panel power control.
The source specifies an electrical connection for SPS30 SEL without changing sensor-board placement, orientation, alignment, or accessibility.
The SPS30 SEL connection does not affect the ESP32 module selection or full-pin breakout requirements.
The SPS30 mode-selection wiring has no effect on battery connector placement or accessibility.
The SPS30 SEL connection does not change DCDC1 output configuration or the target 3.3V rail regulation.
